 High speed, ultra low input latency: 

 Designed to deliver the ultimate competitive advantage for gamers, GameSir G7 comes with a polling rate at 265Hz, and a low response time <0.004s. Destroy the input latency and Dominate the battlefield by making your every move ever more seamless.

 

 

 2 Swappable paint-friendly faceplates, effortless and endless customizations: 

 
 Personalize a unique Xbox controller and instantly stand out. Our 2 swappable paint-friendly faceplates empower you to paint and customize G7 to your heart's content, without taking apart the controller. Enjoy expressing yourselves when customizing, no matter to you or your loved one.

 

 

 Fully software-customizable: 

 The GameSir Nexus software brings even more customizationand fun to the G7 controller. Create controller profiles by mapping buttons, tweaking D-pad diagonal, adjusting sticks & triggers zone, configuring vibration, etc. You can even easily set 0 Deadzone and switch between Default and our exclusive “Raw” mode via the GameSir Nexus software. Experience the exclusive impulse triggers for all games. Save up to 3 profiles and use any your prefer for each game. The software also allows you to update firmware for your controller.

 

 

 Best-in-class consistent smoothness: 

 GameSir precision-tuned tech in the Hall Effect analog triggers delivers best-in-class consistent smoothness and precision, reacting to even the slightest adjustment of your fingertips thanks to the pioneer Hall Effect technology. For FPS and action gamers, there’s even a quick switch to Hair Trigger Mode by holding M+LT/RT buttons until the controller vibrates. Whether you need precise linear control or ultimate responsiveness, G7 controller gives you the competitive edge as you need.

 

 

 Tactile yet cushioned face buttons: 

 Specially-tuned GameSir tactile face buttons come with a 5-layer structure. Microswitches deliver fast actuation with a minimized actuation distance of 0.6mm only, while the embedded kit that includes a soft rubber pad and a bracket produces satisfying presses along with a crisp yet cushioned feel.

 

 

 
 High-performance sticks: 

 Algorithm-optimized joysticks, with 0 Fluctuation, 0 Deviation and 0 Circularity error, deliver 360° seamless pinpoint control. You can even easily set 0 Deadzone and switch between Default and the exclusive “Raw” mode via the GameSir Nexus software, getting an enhanced gaming experience in different games. The anti-friction glide rings provide super-smooth stick control, reducing stick grinding and extending usage time.

 

 

 
 Hyper-realistic Quad motor structure : 

 2 distinct rumble motors in the grips for strong and subtle vibrations. 2 motors inside the triggers bring the feedback to your fingertips. Experience the real, precise feedback of impacts, gunshots and driving over surface irregularities.

 

 

 Audio. Alter. Awesome.:

 *It’s for adjusting your headset’s volume. You need to plug in your headset for volume control.

 Designed for pro-level mobile gaming, GameSir G7 comes with 2 additional back buttons so you can map your in-game actions on the fly, and load up your favorite button mappings with or without software during gameplay. Mappings are instantly programmable and synced in real-time.

 Step 3: Red mode indicator displays ON when connected successfully.

 Note: You need to pair with the original Switch wired controller to boot. If it is not the original controller, they will not be able to connect successfully.

GameSir G7 Pro Wired Controller for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Wireless Gamepad for PC&Android with TMR Sticks, Hall Effect Analog Triggers, 1000Hz Polling Rate, 3.5mm Audio Jack 

 
• Tri-mode Connectivity: Wired for Xbox, 2.4G & Wired for PC, and Bluetooth for Android. The G7 Pro supports seamless connectivity across Xbox, PC, and Android. Effortlessly switch between modes using the convenient physical mode switch. 

• TMR Sticks: The G7 Pro features GameSir's Mag-Res TMR sticks, combining Hall Effect durability with traditional potentiometer performance. This advanced technology delivers stable polling rates for smooth, drift-free gaming with low power consumption. 

• Hall Effect Analog Triggers: The GameSir precision-tuned Hall Effect analog triggers provide unmatched smoothness and linear input for precise control. Featuring clicky Micro Switch trigger stops, gamers can easily switch based on their preferences. 

• 1000Hz Polling Rate on PC: Experience ultra-responsive gaming with a 1000Hz polling rate on PC, available through both wired and 2.4G wireless connections. This ensures instantaneous input registration, reducing lag and optimizing your performance for the most competitive gameplay. 

• GameSir Nexus App: The G7 Pro is compatible with the upgraded GameSir Nexus app, which brings a significant upgrade over the original. It introduces powerful new features such as gyro settings, stick curve adjustments, and button-to-mouse mapping, giving you deeper customization and more control than ever before. 

• PC Gyro Aiming & 4 Extra Buttons: Built-in gyroscope (PC-only) maps to sticks, buttons, or mouse for precise and intuitive gameplay. Four customizable buttons (L5/R5 bumpers + lockable back buttons) enable macros and quick actions. 

• Smart Auto Start-Stop Charging Station: The G7 Pro comes with a Smart Auto Start-Stop Charging Station and a built-in 1200mAh battery, delivering extended battery life for hours of uninterrupted gameplay. Simply place the controller on the station to begin charging, and pick it up to play.

Experience the Power of the PlayStation 5 Controller

 The SONY PS5 DualSense Wireless Controller is one of the most advanced gaming controllers ever created, delivering a completely new level of immersion, responsiveness, and comfort for PlayStation gamers. Designed specifically for the PlayStation 5 console, the DualSense controller introduces revolutionary features such as adaptive triggers, immersive haptic feedback, and a redesigned ergonomic structure that transforms the way players interact with games.

 Unlike traditional controllers, the DualSense is designed to make players truly feel the game world around them. Every movement, explosion, weapon action, and environmental interaction becomes more realistic thanks to Sony’s next-generation feedback technology. Whether you are exploring open-world adventures, racing at high speed, or competing online, the DualSense controller enhances every moment with precision and immersion.

 Advanced Haptic Feedback Technology

 One of the biggest innovations of the PS5 DualSense controller is its advanced haptic feedback system. Instead of simple vibration motors found in older controllers, the DualSense uses highly responsive haptic motors capable of simulating different sensations and textures directly in your hands.

 Players can feel:

 Different road surfaces while driving

Rainfall and environmental effects

Weapon recoil and impact

Footsteps across various terrains

Explosions and collisions

 This technology creates a much deeper connection between the player and the game, making gameplay feel more realistic and immersive than ever before.

 Adaptive Triggers for Realistic Gameplay

 The DualSense controller also introduces adaptive triggers on the L2 and R2 buttons. These triggers dynamically change resistance depending on the in-game action being performed.

 For example:

 Pulling a bowstring feels tighter

Driving vehicles changes trigger pressure

Firing weapons creates unique resistance

Accelerating in racing games feels more realistic

 This feature adds another layer of immersion and helps games feel physically interactive rather than simply visual experiences.

 Comfortable Ergonomic Design

 Sony redesigned the PS5 controller with comfort and long gaming sessions in mind. The DualSense features improved grips, refined analog sticks, balanced weight distribution, and a modern ergonomic shape that fits naturally in the hands.

 Whether you are playing competitively for hours or relaxing with story-driven games, the controller remains comfortable and responsive throughout extended gameplay sessions.

 The iconic PlayStation button layout remains familiar while introducing modern improvements that enhance precision and usability.

 Built-In Microphone and Headset Support

 The DualSense controller includes a built-in microphone that allows players to communicate instantly without requiring a headset. This is especially useful for quick multiplayer communication and casual online gaming.

 For users who prefer dedicated audio devices, the controller also includes a standard 3.5mm headset jack compatible with most gaming headsets and earphones.

 Additional features include:

 Dedicated mute button

Clear voice communication

Easy headset connectivity

Fast voice control access

 Wireless Freedom with USB-C Charging

 The PS5 DualSense controller supports wireless connectivity through Bluetooth technology while also allowing wired gameplay using a USB-C cable. The upgraded USB-C interface enables faster charging and more stable wired connectivity compared to older Micro-USB controllers.

 The built-in rechargeable battery provides long gaming sessions on a single charge, making the controller suitable for both casual and competitive gamers.

 Compatible with Multiple Platforms

 Although designed primarily for PlayStation 5, the DualSense controller can also be used on:

 PC

Laptop

Mobile devices

PS Remote Play

Certain compatible games and platforms

igeek-dgyaco.description:
Xbox Wireless Controller — Electric Volt 

 Elevate your gaming experience with the Xbox Wireless Controller in Electric Volt, a bold and energizing take on Microsoft's acclaimed controller design that combines the precision engineering and ergonomic excellence of the standard Xbox controller with a striking, high-voltage yellow finish that demands attention in any gaming setup. Purpose-built for the Xbox Series X and Series S generation while remaining broadly compatible across a wide ecosystem of devices, the Electric Volt controller delivers the responsive, comfortable, and reliable performance that Xbox players worldwide have come to depend on.

 Engineered with refined ergonomics that feel natural in the hands through even the longest gaming sessions, the controller features a sculpted grip design with textured surfaces on the back and triggers that provide a confident, secure hold and minimize the likelihood of slippage during intense gameplay moments. The reduced input latency enabled by the latest Xbox Wireless technology ensures that every button press, trigger pull, and thumbstick movement is translated to on-screen action with near-instantaneous precision, giving competitive players the responsiveness they demand.

 The redesigned Share button makes capturing and sharing your greatest gaming moments effortless, allowing you to save screenshots and record video clips with a single press without interrupting the flow of gameplay. The hybrid D-pad delivers precise, reliable directional inputs across all eight directions, providing a consistently accurate and satisfying feel for fighting games, platformers, and any title that demands precise directional control.

 Textured grip on the triggers and bumpers adds an additional layer of tactile control, enhancing the feel and confidence of every in-game action from precision shooting to high-speed braking. The controller connects seamlessly via Xbox Wireless or Bluetooth, providing flexible connectivity options across Xbox consoles, Windows PCs, Android devices, and iOS devices, making it a truly versatile controller for the entire Microsoft gaming ecosystem.

 USB-C charging ensures fast, convenient cable management using the most universally compatible modern standard, while compatibility with the Xbox Rechargeable Battery Pack provides an alternative wireless charging solution for players who prefer to keep cables off their gaming surface entirely.

gameon-9hp17s.description:
GameSir G7 Pro Wireless Controller for Xbox, PC & Android with TMR Sticks, Hall Effect Analog Triggers, 1000Hz Polling Rate, 3.5mm Audio Jack - Wuchang: Fallen Feathers Edition 

 
• Officially Licensed Wireless Controller for Xbox: As GameSir’s first wireless controller for Xbox, it features 2.4G wireless connection and one-press wake-up for Xbox consoles, providing you with fast, reliable gameplay and effortless console activation. 

• Tri-mode connectivity: The G7 Pro Wuchang: Fallen Feathers edition supports seamless connectivity across Xbox, PC, and Android. Effortlessly switch between modes using the convenient physical mode switch. Choose from 2.4G Wireless & Wired for Xbox consoles and PC; Bluetooth 5.3 for Android. 

• Hall Effect Analog Triggers: The GameSir precision-tuned Hall Effect analog triggers provide unmatched smoothness and linear input for precise control. Featuring clicky Micro Switch trigger stops, gamers can easily switch based on their preferences. Additionally, the G7 Pro Wuchang: Fallen Feathers edition offers a Hair Trigger Mode that can be activated by holding the M+LT/RT buttons. Whether you need precise linear control or ultimate responsiveness, it gives you the competitive edge. 

• 1000Hz Polling Rate: Experience ultra-responsive gaming with a 1000Hz polling rate on PC, available through both wired and 2.4G wireless connections. This ensures instantaneous input registration, reducing lag and optimizing your performance for the most competitive gameplay. 

• Smart Auto Start-Stop Charging Station: The G7 Pro Wuchang: Fallen Feathers edition comes with a smart auto start-stop charging station and a built-in 1200mAh battery, delivering extended battery life for hours of uninterrupted gameplay. Simply place the controller on the station to begin charging, and pick it up to play. The station also includes a receiver storage compartment at the base, allowing you to extend the cable’s reach or to securely store the receiver when not in use.

 COMPATIBLE

 The PXN V9 steering wheel is compatible with a huge range of devices via the USB connection port. Compatible devices include: PS4 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X&S/ PC / PS3/ Nintendo Switch and Windows 7/8/10 operating systems. (Please download our application PXN Play or V9 Tools to test the function and mapping buttons).

 PC GAMES

 The PXN-V9 game steering wheel can be used with many of your favorite PC games, such as European Truck Simulator, Truck Life, Maxthon China, Shenli Corsa and other games; on Xbox the PXN V9 can be adapted to Horizon 4, Dust 2.0, Forza Motorsport series, Racing Project 2 and other games; PS compatible games include Need for Speed 20, F1 2019, Super Touring Car, Driving Club and more, while Nintendo Switch compatible games include Asphalt, Sonic Racing, Mario Kart and other games.

 Users of the PXN V9 racing wheel can also configure their wheel to their own precise specification using the "V9 Tools" app available in the Apple App Store to download and install.

 The PXN V9 racing wheel has 270/900° rotation that can be adjusted by toggling a button under the steering wheel. This, along with the 6-in-one manual gearshift lever (including forward gears, reverse gear and handbrake) gives players a range of realistic driving options to suit their game. Whatever your game, the PXN V9 will guarantee the most realistic experience.

 NUMEROUS MODES

 The PXN V9 can be used in numerous modes, with a three-in-one linear pedal set-up including clutch, brake and accelerator. You can adjust the strength of the pedals to customise control of the throttle and brake pedals, and the steering wheel can be rotated between 270/900° to suit the game or your own preferences. Not only that but the PXN V9 feels great in your hands too, with its rubber coated wheel that’s also equipped with sports car-style paddles for manual gear shifting, imitating the ergonomic design of racing wheels.

Product Description

 
 

 Become a Racing Legend 

 The Horizon Festival has arrived in Japan, and this controller was built to get you there. The XBOX Wireless Controller Forza Horizon 6 Limited Edition draws its design from the Touge, the winding mountain roads hailed as the birthplace of drifting. A transparent cyan blue top case eases into a metallic gradient, accentuated with volt green, hot pink, and silver details that celebrate the energy of the Horizon Festival and Japan's iconic street racing culture.*
 
 Every Detail Tells the Story 

 This isn't just a color swap. Every element connects back to the world of Forza Horizon 6. The translucent case and triggers reveal dynamic lighting effects from a vibrant pink and green XBOX button. A silver metallic D-pad and two-tone rubberized diamond grips reference the precision of performance driving. The Horizon logo stamped on the battery door finishes the look for collectors and racers alike. With up to 40 hours of battery life, it's built for the long haul, from neon-lit Tokyo streets to open mountain roads.*
 
 Take the Festival Everywhere 

 Pair wirelessly to your console, then switch to your Windows PC or stream games across mobile, gaming handhelds, Smart TVs, and supported VR headsets with XBOX Cloud Gaming.** Capture and share your open-world moments with the dedicated Share button. One controller, every screen you race on.
 
 Make It Yours 

 Use the XBOX Accessories app to remap buttons and create custom controller profiles as you explore, race, and make your way to the festival.*
 
 Important Info 

 
• *Game sold separately. Compatible with select devices and operating system versions; learn more at xbox.com/controller-compatibility. Use with controller compatible games. Battery life varies significantly with headsets, additional accessories, usage, and other factors. Testing conducted by Microsoft using standard AA batteries in preproduction units. Button mapping available via XBOX Accessories app for XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, and Windows 11; app for Windows 10/11 requires compatible USB-C cable (sold separately). 

• **XBOX Cloud Gaming requires Game Pass subscription (not included with PC Game Pass) and supported device (both sold separately). Cloud playable games not included with Game Pass are sold separately and may be made available with Game Pass in the future. Game catalog varies (xbox.com/play). Stream directly on XBOX consoles, or with the XBOX app or at xbox.com/play on supported devices. Select regions (xbox.com/regions) and devices (xbox.com/cloud-devices).

 Thrustmaster T248

 Compatible with Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and PC

 Designed for all gamers looking for performance and immersion and wanting to free themselves from their keyboard, mouse or gamepad, or improve their skills after starting out with a beginner’s wheel, T248 is a racing wheel officially licensed for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and compatible with PC.

 
 
 
 
• Premium design with leather wrapping on the outer-facing portion of the wheel 

• Up to 25 action buttons including 2 dual-position encoders 

• Interactive race dashboard with more than 20 different displays on the wheel’s screen 

• On-the-fly Force Feedback level adjustment: 3 Force Feedback curves (presets included) 

• Next-gen HYBRID DRIVE system: 70% more power than other Thrustmaster hybrid racing wheels (TMX series) 

• Super-responsive magnetic paddle shifters 

• Magnetic pedal set with 4 spring configurations for the brake pedal 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 PRODUCT DESCRIPTION

 
 
 
 
 
 

: 
 
 
 

: 
 
 
 

: 

 
 
 
 THRUSTMASTER RACE DASHBOARD DISPLAY

 T248 features a selection of more than 20 different displays on its built-in screen: manual adjustment of a range of settings (selection of Force Feedback type, the wheel's rotation angle, etc.), or the user’s choice of telemetry information (gear ratio, RPM, gamer’s best lap time, etc.).

 The list of compatible games on PC and Xbox console are available on the Thrustmaster website, and regularly updated.

: 
 
 
 DYNAMIC FORCE FEEDBACK

 T248 features 3 types of Force Feedback (presets included), compatible with all games and modifiable on the fly directly on the wheel:

 FFB 1: Force Feedback 100% proportional to the force requested by the game.

 FFB 2: enhanced Force Feedback, for better skid control.

 FFB 3: boosted Force Feedback, allowing users to clearly feel all racing effects from the track (curbs, skidding off-track, etc.).

: 
 
 
 NEXT-GEN HYBRID DRIVE SYSTEM

 Providing gamers with extra power (up to 70% more than the previous Thrustmaster hybrid racing wheel, TMX), T248 dominates racetracks thanks to its intensity.

 The outstanding drivability made possible by this hybrid system avoids counterintuitive sensations and friction problems commonly found in racing wheels without a belt drive component.

: 

 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 PRODUCT DESCRIPTION

 
 
 
 
 
 

: 
 
 
 

: 
 
 
 

: 

 
 
 
 25 ACTION BUTTONS

 Including 2 dual-position encoders (up and down) located on the ends of the wheel’s central spokes, T248 features nearly twice as many action buttons as previous Thrustmaster racing wheels (TMX series).

 This extensive range of physical and virtual buttons allows users to always have plenty of choices when it comes to assigning racing controls, in any type of game.

: 
 
 
 MAGNETIC PADDLE SHIFTERS

 Thanks to H.E.A.R.T magnetic technology, T248’s paddle shifters allow for super-fast gear shifting, with clear and precise activation feel (30 ms response time) to avoid driving errors.

 This proprietary technology, based on a contactless system of magnets without any friction, also allows for an unprecedented product lifespan over the long term — even with the most intense gaming sessions.

: 
 
 
 MAGNETIC PEDAL SET

 Providing truly exceptional, thousandth-of-a-second precision, the T3PM magnetic pedal set also allows for 4 pressure modes on the brake pedal.

 With completely smooth motion and avoiding the loss of precision over time experienced by standard potentiometer-based pedal sets, T3PM represents a huge, striking leap forward both in terms of versatility and in-game responsiveness.
